title: How Much Do Coding Agents Over-Edit, and Why? An Empirical Study of Unneeded Edits in Repository-Level Agent Patches
summary: Agent patches are larger than developers', which is widely read as over-editing. But patch size does not say whether the extra edits are needed, what they are, or where they come from. We introduce Delta Residue Attribution (DRA), which replays agent trajectories, traces every block (unit) of the final patch to the step that wrote it, reverts each unit, and reruns the task tests to decide whether the unit is needed. We apply DRA to 7,660 resolved GitHub Copilot CLI trajectories from 18 frontier models on SWE-bench Verified (6,728) and DeepSWE (932), and grade developer patches using the same method. Agent patches do change more lines than developers'; on SWE-bench Verified the majority of extra edits add tests (61%) and documentation (13%) while on DeepSWE, most extra edits are code (58%). On both benchmarks, agents' code is on average at least as necessary as developers' (mean $NP_{code}$ 0.887 vs. 0.864 on SWE-bench Verified, where 11 of 18 models leave less unneeded code than developers, and 0.797 vs. 0.785 on DeepSWE). On average, 11% of an agent patch's code units on SWE-bench Verified are still unneeded, and 89% of those change behavior. Debug steps write almost none of the unneeded code. Code necessity differs substantially by model; it is unrelated to resolve rate on SWE-bench Verified and negatively correlated with it on DeepSWE (Spearman -0.59, p = 0.01). On SWE-bench Verified, pruning with DRA using only the tests the agent can see (its own tests and the repository's) removes the majority of unneeded code but also some needed code (67% recall, 46% precision), and 89% of pruned patches still resolve the task; asking the agent to audit its own diff is more precise but less effective (36% recall, 66% precision). We recommend that benchmarks report code necessity
facts: 提出Delta Residue Attribution（DRA），回放智能体轨迹、将最终补丁每个单元追溯到写入步骤、逐一回退并重跑测试判定必要性；应用于18个前沿模型在SWE-bench Verified（6728条）与DeepSWE（932条）上的7660条已解决GitHub Copilot CLI轨迹，并以同法评估开发者补丁；SWE-bench Verified上额外编辑61%为测试、13%为文档，DeepSWE上58%为代码；两基准上智能体代码平均必要性不低于开发者（0.887对0.864；0.797对0.785），SWE-bench Verified上11/18模型不必要代码少于开发者；平均11%代码单元不必要，其中89%改变行为；调试步骤几乎不产生不必要代码；代码必要性与解决率在SWE-bench Verified无关、在DeepSWE负相关（Spearman -0.59）；仅用可见测试剪枝召回67%、精确率46%，89%剪枝后补丁仍解决任务；让智能体自审更精确但效果更弱（召回36%、精确率66%）。
analysis: 该研究用可回退重跑的归因方法把'补丁大小'这一粗糙代理指标替换为单元级必要性度量，结论纠正了'智能体过度编辑'的直觉：额外编辑多为测试与文档，代码必要性并不逊于开发者。剪枝实验显示仅凭可见测试难以可靠区分必要与不必要代码，说明基准应报告代码必要性而非仅解决率。
technical_value: DRA是可复用的补丁归因与必要性评估框架，对智能体评测、补丁剪枝与训练信号设计均有方法学贡献。
impact: 可能改变编码智能体基准的报告规范，并影响对'过度编辑'的行业判断与剪枝工具设计。

title: Enhancing Maritime Domain Awareness using Latent Space Representations
summary: This work presents a novel application of Earth Observation (EO) embeddings for Maritime Domain Awareness (MDA) from the perspective of the geospatial foundation model TerraMind. By operating directly on compressed latent-space representations rather than on the original Sentinel-1 imagery, this approach directly addresses the data gravity bottleneck that increasingly constrains operational EO processing, in line with the objectives of the Embed2Scale project. In particular, linear and non-linear probing of compressed embeddings, latent space representations of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery, is used to detect, localise, and characterise vessels from Sentinel-1 GRD images. Vessel detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.95, while vessel localisation has a median error of around 300 m for vessels longer than 100 m, and vessel AIS type-code classification achieves 62% accuracy for the majority classes. The latter, however, is highly correlated with vessel length. These results reveal both the potential and current limitations of Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) when applied to fine-grained MDA understanding in real-world scenarios. Additionally, a new maritime remote sensing dataset is released, pairing about 2,000 Sentinel-1 images with temporally aligned AIS signals from commercial vessels. Through manual inspection, each candidate sample was verified for bounding-box quality and for consistency between the AIS-reported vessel length and the observed vessel extent, cross-checking vessel identity and location against publicly available vessel records and, where available, photographs. The dataset was made ready for use with the NeuCo-Bench neural compression benchmark framework, publicly available on HuggingFace through https://huggingface.co/datasets/embed2scale/S
facts: 该工作基于TerraMind地理空间基础模型，直接在Sentinel-1 SAR影像的压缩潜空间表示上做线性与非线性探测，用于船舶检测、定位与AIS类型分类；检测ROC-AUC为0.95，长度超100米船舶定位中位误差约300米，多数类AIS类型分类准确率62%且与船长高度相关；同时发布约2000幅Sentinel-1影像与时间对齐AIS信号配对的数据集，已适配NeuCo-Bench并公开于HuggingFace。
analysis: 核心思路是绕开原始影像、在潜空间上做下游任务，以缓解对地观测中的数据引力瓶颈，这与Embed2Scale项目目标一致。结果说明GeoFM在粗粒度检测上已可用，但细粒度语义理解（类型分类）仍受船长等混杂因素主导，作者也明确承认这一局限。
technical_value: 验证了压缩嵌入可直接支撑MDA任务，为降低带宽与算力开销的运营化EO流水线提供实证；配套数据集与基准框架提升了可复现性。
impact: 对海事监控、SAR运营处理与地理空间基础模型评测有直接参考价值，但分类精度尚不足以替代人工或专用模型。

title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
summary: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. Its estimated generation cost per recovered problem is nearly identical, while its cost per accepted trace is 30% lower. Post-training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on traces mined by DART achieves the highest point estimate in five of six evaluations across MATH-500 and AIME benchmarks. These results demonstrate that revisiting rejected traces with DART can expand problem coverage and provide effective post-training data.
facts: 提出DART方法：从被拒绝的推理轨迹出发，分解为推理步骤并按位置加权不确定性排序，对高排名步骤借助参考答案引导和元思考生成差异化替代候选并补全轨迹；在DeepMath-103K贪心未解问题上，同等生成轨迹数下比蒙特卡洛采样多恢复37%的问题，每个被接受轨迹成本低30%；用DART挖掘的轨迹后训练Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，在MATH-500与AIME六项评测中五项取得最高点估计。
analysis: 该方法把'失败轨迹'视为可再利用资源，通过步骤级不确定性定位与受控重写提升难题覆盖率，属于数据挖掘与后训练数据构造层面的改进，而非模型结构创新。成本对比显示其效率优势主要来自接受率提升。
technical_value: 提供可复用的拒绝轨迹再挖掘流程，对数学推理后训练数据稀缺问题有工程价值；但依赖参考答案引导，存在答案泄漏与泛化性疑问。
impact: 对LLM数学推理后训练数据管线有实用意义，可能推动'失败样本再利用'成为标准做法。

title: $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents
summary: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session. We introduce $μ$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction. Simulated participants act from isolated profiles of goals, knowledge, and permissions, adapting to the agent's speech and tool outcomes. Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free). Joint Task Success (JTS) requires all user goals, privacy boundaries, and terminal states to hold jointly, while Pure JTS further disallows unauthorized tool calls; Attribution, Threading, and Coordination (ATC) diagnostics localize failures. Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%. ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models lag primarily in multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that larger groups consistently degrade joint task success across capable systems. By coupling reactive multi-user simulation with verifiable session-level outcomes, $μ$-Bench provides a rigorous testbed for shared voice agents.
facts: 提出μ-Bench，面向闭环全双工多用户语音交互的联合任务完成基准；模拟参与者基于隔离的目标、知识与权限档案行动并随智能体语音与工具结果自适应；覆盖20个领域、100个场景、800个用例（408个含工具、392个无工具）；联合任务成功需同时满足所有用户目标、隐私边界与终止状态，Pure JTS进一步禁止未授权工具调用；13个语音智能体中闭源系统最高62.24%（无工具）与65.44%（含工具），开源权重模型低于20%；诊断显示开源模型主要落后于多轮归因与线程化，且群体规模增大会一致降低成功率。
analysis: 现有语音智能体评测多为单用户或开环，μ-Bench补上了多用户权限冲突与实时反应这一空白，其ATC诊断能定位失败环节而非仅给总分，方法学上较扎实。开源与闭源差距显著，说明多用户协调仍是难点。
technical_value: 提供可验证的会话级联合成功指标与失败归因维度，对多用户语音智能体研发有基准价值。
impact: 将推动共享空间语音助手（车载、家庭、公共终端）的评测标准化，并暴露开源模型在多用户场景的明显短板。

title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
summary: AlphaProof Code agents wrote three million lines of proofs in Lean to verify Signal’s core encryption.
facts: Google DeepMind发布AlphaProof Code，称其智能体用Lean编写三百万行证明以验证Signal核心加密。
analysis: 这是形式化验证与智能体结合在真实安全关键软件上的大规模案例，三百万行证明的规模本身值得关注；但输入未提供证明覆盖率、人工介入比例与验证范围细节，需谨慎看待'验证核心加密'的完整程度。
technical_value: 展示了智能体生成大规模形式化证明的可行性，对密码协议与安全软件的机器可验证保证有示范意义。
impact: 若方法可推广，将影响安全关键软件的形式化验证流程与成本结构。
